record: Paper version decision - submit as Version B (preference reported descriptively, no preference-ordering or mechanism-quality claim)
decision: The paper is submitted in Version B framing. Section 6.5 reports the preference study descriptively (kappa = 0.5776, below the declared 0.60 floor) and supports no preference ordering; no mechanism-quality claim is made; selector rungs 2-4 remain unavailable as stated in section 6.6. No number, table, figure or gate changes. The manuscript status line and the Version A/B row in PAPER_CLAIMS_2026-11-16.md are updated to record this decision.
reason: the study was run at the declared sample size and missed its reliability floor; publishing an ordering at that reliability is the error the judge-noise literature warns about, and adjudicating 80 disagreements after seeing the kappa would be a rule change after a result
